finding: Before the fix: the planner could not distinguish an operator that unlocks a genuinely more valuable follow-on compromise from a structurally-identical dead end, because business_impact/path_progress are both computed strictly against Mission.success_criteria. After adding emergent_impact (2026-08-07): the planner correctly distinguishes them ONCE the downstream edge has been established elsewhere in the graph -- not from a genuine cold start, honestly, since build_graph() never assumes an edge that hasn't actually been confirmed.
